The 内 ('of which') at the foot introduces the male/female split boxed below, which reconciles exactly: 391,788 + 385,223 = 777,011. The printed label is 人員; MASTER records this row as 人口, which is an interpretive rename rather than what the page prints.

Domain-boundary marker opening the entry for Shibata domain (Echigo province, the Mizoguchi house). This is the only marker on the leaf and it governs the whole page: everything to its RIGHT — read earlier — belongs to the previous domain (Shizuoka), and everything to its LEFT is Shibata's. Printed in kyujitai as 新發田 (not 新発田).
○新發田藩
越後蒲原郡 岩代信夫郡 之内
越後（えちご）蒲原郡（かんばらぐん）・岩代（いわしろ）信夫郡（しのぶぐん）の内（うち）

Warichu (split-column inline note) attached to the domain name: Shibata's lands lie 'within Kanbara district of Echigo and Shinobu district of Iwashiro'. Read right sub-column first (越後蒲原郡), then left (岩代信夫郡), then the centred 之内 below. It is printed in the MARKER's column (x1827-1933), not in the 高 column (x1704-1789), so it modifies the domain name rather than the kokudaka figure — MASTER folds this text into its 高 row instead. MASTER's transcription also drops one 郡; the page prints 郡 in both half-columns. These two districts are exactly the two components itemised under 此譯 below.
新發田藩郡名割書
高 拾三萬九千百貳石壹斗八升七合三勺五才
高（たか）十三万九千百二石一斗八升七合三勺五才

Total assessed kokudaka of Shibata domain: 139,102.18735 koku (139,102 koku, 1 to, 8 shō, 7 gō, 3 shaku, 5 sai). Sub-units run strictly descending 石>斗>升>合>勺>才 with no place skipped. Every glyph was re-zoomed at 6-8x because the arithmetic below is 0.9 koku short: the glyph after 百 is unmistakably 貳 (二 over 貝 with the 弋 hook) and the one after 石 is unmistakably 壹 (士 over 冖 over 豆), ruling out the 壹/貳 transposition that would have closed the gap. The 此譯 breakdown to the left splits this between the two districts named in the warichu. MASTER carries two 高 rows for this page, both valued 139,102.18735; only this one is that figure.
高

此の訳（このわけ）

'The breakdown thereof' — a structural connector heading the itemisation of the 139,102.18735-koku total. Printed indented (top at y1087, against y923 for the 高 it breaks down). The breakdown is organised BY PROVINCE, with each district's taxes nested beneath its kokudaka: the Echigo portion (132,399.04313 koku) and its taxes run from here across to the next leaf, where the Iwashiro portion (6,702.24422 koku, 岩代國信夫郡ノ内) and its own 正租/雜稅 then follow.

高 拾三萬二千三百九十九石四升三合壹勺三才
高（たか）十三万二千三百九十九石四升三合一勺三才

First component under 此譯: the Echigo (Kanbara district) portion of Shibata's kokudaka, 132,399.04313 koku — 95.2% of the domain total. The 斗 place is genuinely SKIPPED (石→升→合→勺→才, still strictly descending), so the reading is .04313 and not .4313; a 20-glyph montage confirms it. MASTER records this row's value as 139,102.18735, duplicating the total — the scan clearly disagrees and is trusted here. The remaining Iwashiro portion prints on the next leaf (lower_p082_right) as 6,702.24422 koku; the two components sum to 139,101.28735, which falls 0.9 koku short of the printed total — a genuine internal inconsistency in the source, not a misread (all three figures were re-verified glyph-by-glyph).

Eiraku-sen (cash) component of the miscellaneous tax on Shibata's Echigo holding: 308.677985 kan (308 kan, 677 mon, 9 bu, 8 rin, 5 mō — where 文=.001, 分=.0001, 厘=.00001, 毛=.000001 of a kan). MASTER parses 308.67798, dropping the 毛. The scan's full reading is confirmed by an exact cross-check: the next leaf prints a domain-total 永 of 四百三十壹貫百六十九文六分四厘五毛 = 431.169645, and 308.677985 + 122.49166 (that leaf's Iwashiro 永) = 431.169645 precisely. （原朱）庚午二月ノ調ニ據ル
（原朱／げんしゅ）庚午（かのえうま＝明治三年）二月の調（しらべ）に拠（よ）る

Editorial note in the head margin, set in three short columns read right to left: （原朱）| 庚午二月ノ | 調ニ據ル — '(in the original, in red ink) Based on the survey of the second month of the kanoe-uma year.' Kanoe-uma = Meiji 3 = 1870, dating Shibata's return to the second month of that year. Note the page prints 庚午 alone, without 年 (MASTER's field label supplies it; the scan shows exactly five glyph slots in this sub-column — 庚 午 二 月 ノ — at a uniform ~50px pitch). 原朱 flags that the note stood in vermilion in the manuscript the 1928 movable-type edition reproduces; the scan is grayscale, so it reads as ordinary black here. It sits left of the ○新發田藩 marker and above Shibata's 高 and 此譯 columns, and so belongs to Shibata's entry.
（原朱）庚午年二月ノ調ニ據ル
藩制一覽表第七（新發田）
藩制一覧表（はんせいいちらんひょう）第七（だいなな）（新発田／しばた）

Running header (hashira) in the outer margin of this left-hand page: 'Han Survey Table, fascicle 7 (Shibata)'. This is PROVENANCE, not attribution — it names the domain whose entry opens on this leaf, and does not cover the five Shizuoka columns to the right of the marker (the preceding leaf's header reads 藩制一覽表第七（靜岡）). Printed with the old form 覽, not 覧 — verified at 8x by the dense 臣+丶+又 element over 見.
